substantiveAssessment.requirement: S_VALUE duty 1; VALUE_FIXTURE; common raw-document requirements in SOURCE-BODY-057:1-196.
substantiveAssessment.conclusion: The public graph owns its UTF8 bytes and flat node/index arrays through UE containers. Ordered mapping pairs preserve duplicate and case-distinct keys. Public results expose no vendor/std ownership. The input view is borrowed only during the synchronous call; accepted original bytes are copied before publication. Refusals leave the document empty. Deep copy, move, caller destruction and alias-index lifetime are addressed by the owned APIs and separate Editor caller suite.

substantiveAssessment.requirement: S_VALUE duty 1: private typed exception boundary, original bytes, aliases/tags/UTF8/null restrictions.
substantiveAssessment.conclusion: The exported boundary is noexcept. Private typed refusals are caught there, and vendor ParserException is translated privately. Unknown/allocation exceptions intentionally terminate rather than escape. Stream/parser lifetimes and callback signatures match the pinned public API. Aliases remain unexpanded occurrences targeting stable indices, including rebound anchor identities. Tags are checked before copying. All OnNull callbacks refuse because the callback loses necessary properties. Raw NUL/EOT and malformed input UTF8 refuse before vendor interpretation; decoded embedded/terminal NUL remains length-delimited data. Vendor escape results containing invalid UTF8 refuse as InvalidEventStream.

substantiveAssessment.requirement: S_VALUE duty 1: five inclusive quota units.
substantiveAssessment.conclusion: The source enforces inclusive limits of 1,048,576 input bytes, collection depth 64 with root collection depth 1, 100,000 raw nodes including mapping keys and alias occurrences, 10,000 aliases without expansion, and 65,536 decoded UTF8 bytes per scalar. Above-limit observations and limits are checked independently by the resource suite. These are acceptance quotas, not a promise that vendor decoding performs no earlier allocation.

substantiveAssessment.requirement: S_VALUE duty 2; VALUE_FIXTURE: all 38 IDs, 45 planned attempts and eight suites.
substantiveAssessment.conclusion: All ten canonical and 28 generated definitions were assessed. Independently constructed inert recipe bytes match every generated declared length, SHA256 and SHA1; all ten canonical bodies match both declared hashes and lengths. Expected structures cover ordered Unicode/case-distinct and duplicate keys, anchor rebinding, observable tags and full 78007900 decoded bytes. Nine negative cases require precise typed failures; fifteen resource cases cover below/at/above all five limits. Eight suite attempt counts are 1,2,1,10,4,9,15,3, totaling 45 with 38 distinct IDs. The wrapper checks ordered attempts, input artifacts and hashes, exact typed outcomes, caller mode and ledger membership. Custom check totals count evaluated Check calls before ledger publication and are expressly distinct from UE assertion totals.

Base config/XML/annotated command-line application precedes the derived constructor; target-type overrides, validation gates and platform finalization follow. Inherited selector lists, null OptedInModulePlatforms and the dependency hook were assessed as actual distinct defaults. The conditional all-modules route constructs and filters additional modules after normal setup, with host/platform/configuration/precompile and failure gates; it does not establish universal plugin execution. Prebuild, precompile dependency-list and shared-environment routes were assessed. Windows finalization may change compiler choices and concretize toolchain/SDK values, so requested settings alone do not establish actual effective configuration.
